card.name: Second digit of two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: The second digit of a two-digit number, mostly right after a first digit like 2, 3, 4, 6 or 7. It appears inside percentages, counts, volumes, days and dates.

modes.label: Digit in measurements
modes.description: Second digit in a dose, volume or percentage.
modes.example: a total of 6<<7>> mL of water

modes.label: Digit in counts and durations
modes.description: Second digit in patient counts, percentages or a number of days.

modes.label: Digit in dates
modes.description: Second digit of a day number in a date or a cycle length.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a two-digit number, such as the 1 in 21 days.
